subject.title: [Bug]: tools.elevated.enabled: true breaks exec routing logic (tools.

question: Should an allowed elevated session with no explicit elevatedDefault keep sandbox exec as the default, or should the current elevated-by-default host exec contract remain supported?
rationale: This changes the sandbox escape boundary and can affect existing operator workflows, so automation should not choose the default/security contract.

options.title: Default Elevated Off
options.body: Unset elevatedDefault resolves to off, while /elevated on|ask|full and exec(elevated: true) remain explicit ways to leave the sandbox.

options.title: Keep Current Contract
options.body: Preserve the documented current behavior where allowed elevated sessions default to host exec and ask is an approval-gated alias of on.

options.title: Add Separate Opt-In Mode
options.body: Keep current on/ask semantics but add a distinct mode for sandbox-by-default plus per-call elevation.

recommendation.title: Default Elevated Off
recommendation.body: Unset elevatedDefault resolves to off, while /elevated on|ask|full and exec(elevated: true) remain explicit ways to leave the sandbox.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest current and historical code path ownership signal is on the elevated default and exec routing implementation.
